metaDescription: Sucker rod pumps built to API Spec 11AX requirements, special designs for challenging conditions, barrels, plungers and spare parts.

hero.title: Sucker rod pumps and downhole equipment
hero.lead: Minline Systems supplies sucker rod pumps built to API Spec 11AX requirements, designs adapted to different operating conditions and a broad range of spare parts for artificial lift oil production. The product line is shaped to support reliable, stable operation on both onshore and offshore fields.

cards.title: Pumps built to API Spec 11AX requirements
cards.text: A range of modifications and sizes of insert-type and tubing-type sucker rod pumps.

cards.title: Special designs for challenging conditions
cards.text: Solutions suited to demanding service: sand, corrosive environments, high gas-oil ratio and viscous crude.

cards.title: Spare parts and components
cards.text: A wide range of barrels, plungers, valve elements and other critical components for pump systems.

blocks.title: Sucker rod pumps built to API Spec 11AX requirements
blocks.body: The UKR-LAND product line covers sucker rod pumps in a range of design modifications built to API Spec 11AX requirements. The products are shaped as solutions that meet oil and gas industry requirements for materials, construction, testing and marking. The portfolio includes both insert-type and tubing-type pumps.

specs.label: Main modifications
specs.value: RHA, RHB, RWA, RXB, TH, THM, THOS

columns.title: Insert-type pumps
columns.text: Insert-type pumps are designed to operate inside the tubing string and can be selected in modifications suited to a range of well conditions.

columns.title: Tubing-type pumps
columns.text: Tubing-type pumps offer a wider application range and matching design options, making them an effective solution for certain well parameters.

blocks.title: Solutions for challenging operating conditions
blocks.body: In some wells, sand production, corrosive environments, a high gas-oil ratio or viscous crude place additional demands on standard equipment. Material selection, coating technology and design choices therefore have to be defined against the specific service conditions.

subitems.title: Sandy wells
subitems.text: Sand cleaner elements, grooved plungers and anti-sand solutions can be applied to reduce the effect of sand and solid particles.

subitems.title: Corrosive environments
subitems.text: Corrosion-resistant materials and special coatings help extend the service life of friction elements.

subitems.title: Case-by-case selection
subitems.text: Equipment selection should account for well depth, operating regime, fluid composition, temperature, pressure and abrasiveness.

blocks.title: Barrels
blocks.body: Barrels for sucker rod pumps can be supplied in several variants to suit different operating conditions. The choice is based on well parameters, fluid properties and the required level of durability.
bullets: steel barrels with carbonitriding and chrome plating

blocks.title: Plungers
blocks.body: Plungers can be supplied in designs suited to different operating conditions. Dedicated solutions are available for sandy wells, corrosive environments and abrasive service.
bullets: grooved plungers for wells with sand production
PA-type plungers with chemical and abrasion resistance

blocks.title: Spare parts and components
blocks.body: A wide range of spare parts and components can be supplied for the assembly, maintenance and repair of pump systems.

cta.title: Let's select the right pump solution for your well conditions
cta.text: Share your well parameters and operating conditions, and we will support you in selecting suitable equipment.
